hook: Nearly 24 percent of European airline pilots fly while too fatigued.

sections.voiceover: Nearly 24 percent of European airline pilots fly while too fatigued.
In October 2026, the European Cockpit Association published a survey of 7,200 captains and first officers. Where did 75 percent of pilots experience microsleeps?
Worse, three in four European airline pilots have experienced microsleeps in the cockpit.
The European Cockpit Association survey revealed that 50.3 percent of participating pilots consider that fatigue risk is not well managed.
In October 2026, Euronews reported that more than half of surveyed pilots admitted flying while tired.
